description.value:
From Red Hot Chili Pepper · Price: it only travels through wires, metal or water.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: Your stand can enter a wire, metal object or water within range and move through it at double Speed. A Strike from inside deals @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[electricity]] extra.
  • 5: Surge: discharge into a creature touching connected metal or water: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[electricity]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 9: Drain power: touch a power source or charged object to gain a +2 status bonus to stand Strike damage for 1 minute.
  • 13: The discharge hits every creature touching the same metal or water.
  • 17: Your stand can travel through power lines or rivers up to 1 mile.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.bFQnDF7V15RXofYC]{Effect: Drained Power}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
